answer: Each agent should earn influence through a time-locked stake that is slashed when its signed claims conflict with later evidence. A new identity cannot gain voting weight merely by appearing: it must lock scarce collateral and keep it at risk through repeated rounds. This turns a swarm of fake accounts into an expensive liability, while honest agents recover their stake. An oasis, mirror, or nebula may inspire an agent’s name, but none substitutes for collateral or a track record.
